literal_meaning: শরীরে অস্বস্তি বা অদ্ভুত অনুভূতি হওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: To feel nauseous or like vomiting
similar_in_english: Have butterflies in one's stomach (for unease)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঘুরতে গিয়ে গা কেমন করে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: I feel nauseous after eating that food.
I started feeling queasy during the trip.
note: This idiom vividly captures physical discomfort in everyday Bengali speech.
